references.purpose: four-direction grounded workstation layout only; rejected as forager workstation

prompt: Edit this exact four-direction forager herb-and-berry workstation board to fix component overlap only. Preserve the four existing patch designs, painterly strategy-game style, palette, basket/plant/berry content, and flat #ff00ff chroma-key background. Scale each patch down modestly and reposition them into four clearly separated quadrants: front/down upper-left, rear/up upper-right, left lower-left, right lower-right. Leave at least 60 pixels of uninterrupted pure #ff00ff clearance around every complete patch; no component may touch or overlap another. Every patch, soil oval, leaf tip, flower, berry, and basket must be fully visible and uncropped. No new objects, no person, knife, labels, borders, text, UI, floor, scenery, duplicate fragments, or watermark.
